detailed_description: The CSV to JSON Converter is a lightweight browser tool for turning pasted delimited text into formatted JSON. Paste CSV text, choose comma, semicolon, tab, or pipe as the delimiter, and decide whether the first row should be treated as object keys. With headers enabled, the output is an array of objects with string values. Without headers, the output is an array of rows. The generated JSON can be copied to the clipboard.
usage_steps: Paste CSV or delimited text into the CSV input area.
Choose the delimiter: comma, semicolon, tab, or pipe.
Turn the header-row option on if the first line contains field names.
Click Convert to generate formatted JSON in the output area.
Copy the generated JSON when you are done.
usage_examples: Convert a small spreadsheet export with headers into an array of JSON objects.
Turn semicolon-separated values into formatted JSON for a quick prototype.
Paste tab-separated rows and copy the resulting JSON array.
Check how header and non-header CSV data will look as JSON.
